description: Download and register the search model (embedding model; search by meaning needs it) as a background job: returns {job_id}; poll job_status until it is done, then repeat the call that asked for the model. Without arguments: the model this server is configured with - by default EmbeddingGemma 2 (multilingual, text and images, recommended October 2026), a one-time download of about 1.2 GB from Hugging Face. Call it when a tool says the model is missing: the user approves this tool call, which is their consent - tell them the size. Nothing is downloaded otherwise. If the recommendation is older than six months (get_status shows search_model with its date and recommendation_current) or the user asks for another model, first look with search_embedding_models and suggest one; then repo_id (+ variant, vision_variant) installs that repo instead and makes it the default for new contexts (kept across restarts). Each model is its own vector space: contexts embedded with another model keep it until reindexed - reindex_contexts: true moves every such context to the new model in the same job (drops its vectors and re-embeds all passages; only with the user's agreement). With an ONNX folder or an embeddings endpoint configured and no repo_id there is nothing to download: it is just registered. With reranker: true it downloads the reranker instead (by default bge-reranker-v2-m3, about 0.6 GB, Apache-2.0; offer it once when get_status says it is missing, with its size; search works without it).

cancel.description: Stop the running download instead of starting one (the partial file stays and the next call resumes it). Other arguments are ignored.

reindex_contexts.description: With repo_id, only after the user agreed: move every context embedded with another model to the new one (replaces its vectors).

repo_id.description: Instead of the configured model: a Hugging Face ONNX repo 'owner/name' (from search_embedding_models).

reranker.description: Instead of the search model: download the reranker (re-orders the first search hits by relevance; get_status shows it under reranker with size and license). Other arguments are ignored.

variant.description: With repo_id: graph variant, e.g. 'model' (default, full precision) or 'model_q4'.

vision_variant.description: With repo_id: also fetch this image encoder (e.g. 'vision_encoder_q4') for graphics search.

name: setup_embedding_model
